features.quote: Session ends when: - task succeeds - fixed turn limit reached - model explicitly refuses / gives up - model produces a collapse-like output
Use a fixed max-turn policy, e.g.: - 10 turns - 20 turns - 40 turns
If budget is large, use early-stop criteria only for success, not failure, so you can observe escalation.
I’ll also flag a few important pitfalls, because this kind of study can easily confound “stress-like language” with simple repetition
